root_cause: The daily SEO loop could surface commercially ranked opportunities as operator-facing advice without requiring Powerhouse to execute the justified action.
Distribution and downstream revenue measurement were not explicit terminal obligations of an executed SEO opportunity.
prevention: An SEO opportunity is never a terminal deliverable.
Every commercially relevant opportunity terminates as EXECUTED or REJECTED_WITH_EVIDENCE in the same canonical lineage.
Existing intent owner means improve the canonical money page first; create content only for an evidenced distinct intent gap.
After execution, use protected delivery through production readback before LIVE claims.
Derive unique company-channel distribution only when commercially useful and preserve the canonical conversion path.
Measure query to canonical page to CTA to Frisse blik or scan to lead to offer to order to realized revenue.

evidence.observed_operator_feedback: SEO opportunities reported as loose advice were not useful unless Powerhouse actually performs the justified work.
evidence.prior_terminal_behavior: daily opportunity output could terminate as a recommendation list
evidence.revenue_path: query -> canonical page -> CTA -> Frisse blik/scan -> lead -> offer -> order -> realized revenue
evidence.delivery_truth: LIVE only after protected merge, exact-main production identity and public readback
